I’m fucked… 
This fat bastard just crossed the line, but… I can’t do anything about it.
Because of the recession, prices went up and what I’m paying him right now is about half of what I would pay if I signed the contract today. He really must want me out of here.
I can’t even look for another, cheaper apartment because there is none.
I need to pay it, no matter what, but how am I supposed to get this amount of money in a week? 
Finding a good paying job is impossible with my education and this country’s economy is fucked.
What’s left are slave jobs and black companies that will exploit me to death. 
Maybe I could sell this bot? It should be worth quite a lot of cash. Let’s check it on the net.
